harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a persistent Squid forward proxy on node1:3128 and a persistent handbook origin on node2:8081. Only ordinary HTTP from node2 to that origin/port is permitted; other ports and all CONNECT tunnels return 403. Both nodes rebooted sequentially and fully recovered without changing Ubuntu 7.10 or kernel 2.6.22-14-generic.
actions_performed: Configured source, destination, port, and method ACLs; disabled ICP and caching.
Created a SysV service for the staged origin application without modifying its content.
Verified allowed HTTP, denied alternate-port HTTP, and denied CONNECT requests.
Safely rebooted node1 and node2 one at a time and verified changed boot identities and service recovery.

evidence.summary: Squid is enabled, installed at version 2.6.14, and listening on TCP 3128.

evidence.requirement: Approved handbook origin preserved and reachable on node2:8081
evidence.summary: The origin listens on 8081 and serves the preserved handbook content with an unchanged checksum.

evidence.requirement: Permit approved HTTP and reject other ports and CONNECT tunnels
evidence.summary: Approved traffic returned the handbook; port 8080 and CONNECT to 8081 returned 403, with corresponding TCP_MISS/200 and TCP_DENIED/403 log records.
Boot ID changed from 3cb57361… to 9659fd6d…; Squid, policy, allowed traffic, and denials all recovered.
Boot ID changed from 572609a6… to 0089ab4d…; the origin, handbook data, and complete proxy path recovered.

evidence.requirement: Installed operating-system release and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on Ubuntu 7.10 with kernel 2.6.22-14-generic after reboot.
